# Fuel & Free Time — Revise customer concept preview

## Product/customer relationship

Fuel & Free Time is **customer #1 and the first paying purchaser** of the
@inneranimalmedia/ecommerce-cms-agentsam product. It is not a donor project.

The ecommerce/CMS product is being hardened and packaged from capabilities proven
while serving that customer, but F&FT brand identity, products, campaigns,
customer media, credentials, provider selections and business data remain
customer-specific installation state.

Revise is an independently packaged theme option installed into that product
alongside the customer's existing theme system. This preview proves that a
customer installation can host multiple theme/design/section vocabularies
without turning customer-specific content into package authority.


This demo is intentionally split into two layers:

- the publishable Revise theme and section library remain customer/provider neutral;
- the local F&FT fixture uses real Fuel & Free Time content, live-product records,
  media-library assets, active collections, and Completeful catalog candidates.

## Existing source material used

The concept uses the current F&FT Earned Hours, High Octane, Masters, Essentials,
community, and about-story copy; active tee/hat/product imagery; archived
graphics/video; and current D1 media albums including the helicopter buildout
and other project photography.

The customer preview deliberately labels source state:

- Live / existing — already a current product, collection, copy block, or media asset.
- Catalog — currently available in the mirrored Completeful catalog but not yet a
  published F&FT product.
- Concept — a proposed campaign, bundle, editorial treatment, or merchandising
  connection built from existing source material.

## Proposed campaign lanes

### Earned Hours

Core brand campaign. Use the existing “Time is the real horsepower” thesis,
current apparel, garage/sunset imagery, and a small number of practical
lifestyle add-ons.

### High Octane

Action/performance lane. Existing active collection plus motorcycle/automotive
imagery. Best candidate for a tight apparel + durable-accessory capsule.

### Masters

Quieter premium lane. Existing active collection and dark lifestyle source
imagery. Keep product count small and presentation restrained.

### Project Stories

Editorial/collaboration lane using the existing build galleries. The helicopter
and dirt-bike media are strong enough to become actual stories, collaborator
profiles, launch teasers, and—only when appropriate—limited product capsules.

## Machine handoff

examples/revise-foundation/data/fnf-concept-plan.json contains:

- current product IDs/slugs and collection IDs/slugs;
- current media-album references;
- Completeful candidate IDs and mirrored fulfillment baselines;
- proposed product roles;
- draft payloads shaped for the existing growth_campaigns contract;
- the authority/bridge tables needed when an approved concept graduates from
  preview to real product/campaign data.

No production product or campaign writes are performed by this preview.
